product.description: A budgeting app for freelancers: it reads bank exports on the phone, sorts spending into tax categories and shows what to set aside each month. No account, no server.
product.markets: Sold worldwide through the App Store and Google Play; home market the United States and Canada.
requirements: Short, easy to say, easy to spell after hearing it once.
A hint of meaning is welcome; plain made-up names are fine.
A standard-price .app domain (.com is a bonus).
No live trademark conflict in software, finance or tax, and no same-name app in a nearby category.
